import pandas as pd, re
file_path = '/data/mixed_units_register.xlsx'
raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Disbursement Register', header=None)
header = raw.iloc[5].tolist()
data = raw.iloc[6:].copy()
data.columns = header
data = data.rename(columns={data.columns[0]:'Record ID', data.columns[1]:'Disbursement Date', data.columns[2]:'Programme', data.columns[3]:'State', data.columns[4]:'Donor / Scheme', data.columns[5]:'Amount', data.columns[6]:'Purpose'})
data = data[data['Record ID'].astype(str).str.startswith('MU-')].copy()
# function to parse amount
def parse_amount(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return 0
    s = str(val).strip()
    if s.lower() in ('','-','na','nan'):
        return 0
    # remove ₹ and commas
    s_clean = re.sub(r'[₹,]', '', s)
    s_clean = s_clean.strip()
    # handle lakh, L, Cr, k
    # patterns
    # e.g., 1.2 L
    # 2.5 lakh
    # 1 Cr
    # 45k
    # 340000
    # ₹1,20,000 -> 120000
    # 875000
    # try numeric
    # match number + unit
    m = re.match(r'^([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)\s*([a-zA-Z]+)?$', s_clean, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        num = float(m.group(1))
        unit = m.group(2) or ''
        unit = unit.lower()
        if unit in ('l','lakh'):
            return int(num * 100000)
        elif unit in ('cr','crore'):
            return int(num * 10000000)
        elif unit == 'k':
            return int(num * 1000)
        else:
            # no unit, assume plain number
            return int(num)
    # if no match, try extract number
    # fallback
    try:
        # extract all numbers
        nums = re.findall(r'[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?', s_clean)
        if nums:
            return int(float(nums[0]))
    except:
        pass
    return 0

data['Amount_INR'] = data['Amount'].apply(parse_amount)
print(data[['Record ID','Donor / Scheme','Amount','Amount_INR']].head(30))
print('Total rows', len(data))
# Check for any unparsed odd values
odd = data[data['Amount_INR']==0]['Amount'].unique()
print('Zero amount values:', odd)
